candidate.loader: UNETLoader; use diffusion weights, keep existing Wan VAE and UMT5
guideFindings: Author says no style trigger defaults to photorealism.
smoothmixanime and smoothmixrealism select author style families.
T2V v3 explicitly baked Lightx2v; v4 guide does not restate sampling settings. No extra acceleration LoRA in candidate workflow.

decision: Low strength is a promising fidelity candidate. Medium/high strengths redraw substantially but drift toward glossy semi-3D materials. Keep original Wan for now.
scope: One recorded non-explicit anime source. Other media, additional seeds, and NSFW content have not been validated.

sourceStyleProfile.style: anime drawing; soft, blended outlines around figure and background elements; smooth cel shading with gradient transitions on skin and clothing; vivid saturation with high contrast, warm orange and green tones under bright sky; smooth digital paint texture on skin and fabric, no visible brushstrokes or grain
sourceStyleProfile.content: A young woman with short bobbed black hair stands on a rural road. She wears an orange collared shirt with buttoned front, short sleeves, and green shorts with belt loops. A green backpack with straps is worn over her shoulders. She faces slightly right, looking toward viewer. Background shows winding road, grassy fields, distant hills, and blue sky with clouds. Lighting is bright, casting soft shadows on road and clothing.

records.promptChange: Recorded Wan baseline prompt plus author anime trigger, selected from the recorded source medium.
records.settingProvenance: 7-step Euler/beta, CFG 1 and shift 8 from recorded NovaFlow baseline; author style trigger added and external acceleration LoRA removed. This is not a weights-only comparison.
records.assessment: 基本保留姿势、服装配色和原图的柔和动漫表现；发丝、褶皱和路面有重绘，脸、短裤和背景仍有变化。低强度具备保真潜力，尚未经用户验收。
records.qualityAssessmentMethod: Manual inspection of actual generated images against source and recorded original Wan outputs.
